top_categories.workout_context: The Bootlegger's Gravel and paved country roads, Wilson Creek Gorge forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 85 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic The Bootlegger's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
85ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At The Bootlegger, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of The Bootlegger. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 85, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At The Bootlegger, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
7,250ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
7,250ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on western North Carolina mountain gravel with. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 85 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Smooth pedaling at 85 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for The Bootlegger’s 85 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Highly technical terrain at The Bootlegger demands practice on similar surfaces. Ride western north carolina mountain gravel with sustained climbing and technical descents at race-day cadence weekly. Expect: gravel and paved country roads, wilson creek gorge, grandfather ranger district. Practice cornering, descending, and power delivery on unstable surfaces. Dial in tire pressure before race week — 5 PSI wrong costs you 15+ minutes over 85 miles.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 85 miles of western north carolina mountain gravel with sustained climbing and technical descents in Lenoir, North Carolina.
